extraction.Name: Julia Decory Ferrin
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded September 15, 1922, by Lyman Abstract Company
extraction.Buyer: Julia Decory Ferrin and Arthur Ferrin conveyed the land by deed to W. H. Tackett for $4600
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 759608 issued; Northwest quarter section 20, township 58, range 26; receipt for patent was signed by the allottee April 3, 1920; conveyance dated April 7, 1920
